artifact: Role Input Surface and Resource-Control Contract
comparability_principle: Workflow comparison must not silently become a comparison of unequal source access.

contents: frozen claim-support source excerpts/anchors from A3R.1
human_baseline_source_packet.purpose: Give human arms access to the same bounded scientific source substrate without importing D1's synthesized claim conclusions.

R0.interpretation: Human de novo judgment from common case+source substrate.

R1.interpretation: Agent first creates candidate space; expert verifies. High anchoring-risk comparator.

R2.interpretation: Same human baseline substrate as R0 before Agent exposure, then breadth expansion and reconciliation.

resource_control_notes: R0 and R2 pre-AI human phases share the same baseline case/source substrate.
Agent phases may use the structured SRS because Agent breadth/source-recovery is the intervention mechanism being studied.
R1 expert verification must have access to the source spans referenced by Agent candidates; verification cannot be pure trust in Agent prose.
Hidden Day-1 diet values remain unavailable in all ex-ante workflow arms.
D1 ScientificClaim evidential-state labels are not shown to R0/R2 pre-AI experts because they would import prior synthesized judgments.
conformance_rationale: This preserves the intended contrast: Human De Novo vs AgentFirst vs FocusFirst+AgentExpand, rather than unequal raw scientific resource availability.
